metadata.title: Taro Leaf Mehpok | Zomi Recipe
metadata.description:
Mehpok is a simple Zomi dish which is actually a Congee flavoured with pieces of meat and flavoured with herbs and leaves. This is Taro leaf based Mehpok. Taro leaves are known to have anti-cancer properties.
